(dollars in thousands, except for per share amounts)

(1) Net revenues include both management fees and Harveys' equity contribution from the Hard Rock Hotel/Casino. For the twelve months ended November 30, 1995, these amounts include a charge of $1.2 million for preopening expenses.
(2) Nonrecurring items, net of tax, for the three months ended November 30, 1995 include life insurance proceeds of $2.0 million.

Nonrecurring items, net of tax, for the twelve months ended November 30, 1996 include $2.5 million of preopening expenses for the opening of Harveys Casino/Hotel in Council Bluff's, Iowa, and $522,000 for the early retirement of debt attributable to the application of net proceeds from the company's $150-million senior subordinated note offering. Nonrecurring items for the twelve months ended November 30, 1995 include $2.3 million of preopening expenses, net of tax, resulting from the December opening of Harveys Wagon Wheel Hotel/Casino and the March opening of the Hard Rock Hotel/Casino and $2.2 million of life insurance proceeds.
RESULTS OF OPERATIONS - PROPERTY BY PROPERTY
FOR THE PERIODS ENDED NOVEMBER 30, 1996 AND 1995
Three Months Ended Twelve Months Ended

(1) On April 30, 1996, Harveys Wagon Wheel Hotel/Casino became wholly owned by Harveys Casino Resorts. Prior to that time, Harveys held a 70 percent equity interest in the Wagon Wheel, receiving a management fee of 5 percent of adjusted gross revenues. Operating income and EBITDA for the twelve months of 1995 are presented excluding preopening expense of $2.1 million.

(2) Harveys Casino/Hotel in Council Bluffs, Iowa, commenced casino operations January 1, 1996, one month into the first quarter. 1996 operating income and EBITDA are stated excluding a charge for preopening expense of $4.1 million, of which $3.6 million was taken in the first quarter and $508,000 in the second quarter.

(3) Harveys Casino Resorts has a 40 percent equity interest in the Hard Rock Hotel/Casino and receives a management fee of 4 to 6 percent of adjusted gross revenues through its Las Vegas Management Company. Net revenues from the Hard Rock Hotel/Casino, which began operations in March 1995, consist of management fees earned and equity in earnings from this property.
The twelve months of 1995 exclude Harveys pro rata share of preopening expenses, net of tax, of $1.2 million for the Hard Rock Hotel/Casino.

(4) EBITDA is defined as operating income plus depreciation, amortization, and preopening expenses. For the three months and twelve months ended November 30, 1995, EBITDA for corporate and development includes $2.0 million in life insurance proceeds. For the twelve months ended November 30, 1995, EBITDA for Harveys Resort includes $274,000 of life insurance proceeds. SOURCE Harveys Casino Resorts
